note: 30 candidates in this part. The session's shared web-search allowance was already spent when this part began, and WebFetch could not resolve most Kentucky hosts, so pages were read with plain requests carrying the kit's honest User-Agent at addresses taken from the governments' own sites. Bullitt County's site answered with a CAPTCHA page and was not requested again, so nothing is recorded for Tammy R. Baker. Current officeholders were confirmed on their governments' own pages; where the page names someone else in the seat the candidate is seeking (Marion County sheriff: Jimmy Clements; Anderson magistrate District 5: David Montgomery; Pendleton magistrate District 1: Alan Whaley; Woodford magistrate District 6: Mary Ann Gill; Richmond mayor: Robert R. Blythe; Hopkinsville Ward 9: Brittanie Bogard; Erlanger's council page does not list Chris Herrman), no office is recorded for the challenger. No campaign site could be found without search for Rivera, McDaniel, Love, Herrman, Wegman or the county candidates; guessed addresses did not resolve. Nothing was found for the constables, Kiser, Cotton, Peoples, Gampper, Caldwell, Wegman or Fairchild. Bivens is a sitting legislator with a record page: only his website and own words are recorded; his and Rivera's listings on party pages are already in ballot/lean/ky_endorsements.json. Bivens's site carries no year; it names him, the office and central Kentucky and is paid for by 'Ryan Bivens for State Representative'. Start years are left blank where the official page gives none; Tapke's page gives her first election, November 4, 2014 (Kentucky county officers take office the following January).
